name: MonarchFileUpload
title: FileUpload
summary: Chooses files with the system picker, checks their type, size and count, explains refusals and hands the accepted files to the app, which uploads them.
whenToUse: Wherever people attach files: documents to a request, receipts to an expense, photos to a report. Pair it with MonarchUploadQueue to show the uploads.
whenNotToUse: For a profile picture with a crop, use MonarchAvatarUpload. For files the app creates, use ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument.
api: @Composable fun MonarchFileUpload(onFiles: (accepted: List<MonarchPickedFile>, rejected: List<MonarchFileRejection>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchFileUploadVariant = MonarchFileUploadVariant.Zone, picker: MonarchFileUploadPicker = MonarchFileUploadPicker.Documents, accept: List<String> = emptyList(), maxSize: Long? = null, maxFiles: Int? = null, currentCount: Int = 0, multiple: Boolean = maxFiles != 1, enabled: Boolean = true, invalid: Boolean = false, showErrors: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, hint: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, validate: ((MonarchPickedFile) -> String?)? = null, labels: MonarchFileUploadLabels = MonarchFileUploadLabels())
class MonarchPickedFile(uri: Uri, name: String, mimeType: String?, size: Long?) { companion object { fun of(resolver: ContentResolver, uri: Uri): MonarchPickedFile } }
class MonarchFileRejection(file: MonarchPickedFile, code: MonarchFileRejectionCode, message: String)
enum class MonarchFileRejectionCode { InvalidType, TooLarge, TooMany, Custom }

class MonarchFileUploadLabels(label: String? = null, browse: String? = null, limits: ((maxSize: String?, maxFiles: Int?) -> String)? = null, limitReached: ((maxFiles: Int) -> String)? = null, invalidType: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, tooLarge: ((name: String, maxSize: String) -> String)? = null, tooMany: ((name: String, maxFiles: Int) -> String)? = null, added: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, formatSize: ((bytes: Long) -> String)? = null)

object MonarchFileUploadValidator { fun validate(context: Context, files: List<MonarchPickedFile>, accept: List<String> = emptyList(), maxSize: Long? = null, maxFiles: Int? = null, currentCount: Int = 0, multiple: Boolean = maxFiles != 1, labels: MonarchFileUploadLabels = MonarchFileUploadLabels(), validate: ((MonarchPickedFile) -> String?)? = null): MonarchFileUploadValidation }
class MonarchFileUploadValidation(val accepted: List<MonarchPickedFile>, val rejected: List<MonarchFileRejection>)

options.name: onFiles
options.description: Called after every pick with the accepted files (URI, name, MIME type, size) and the refused ones with their code and message. The app uploads the accepted files.

options.name: variant
options.description: A bordered zone with label, hint and button, or one compact line with the button and the hint.

options.name: picker
options.description: The document picker, or the photo picker for photos and videos (no storage permission needed).

options.name: accept
options.description: Allowed types: MIME types, wildcards such as image/* and extensions such as .csv. Empty allows every file. Also filters the picker where the system can.

options.name: maxSize
options.description: The largest size per file, in bytes. Files of unknown size are not refused for size.

options.name: maxFiles
options.description: The most files in total, counting currentCount.

options.name: currentCount
options.description: Files already attached. At maxFiles the button is disabled and the hint says the limit is reached.

options.name: multiple
options.description: Lets the picker return several files; otherwise the single-file picker is used.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can choose files.

options.name: invalid
options.description: Danger border on the zone and errorText set as the button's error, for example when a required file is missing.

options.name: showErrors
options.description: Shows the refusal messages under the zone in a danger MonarchInlineNotice. false leaves them to the app.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon at the start of the zone. Decorative and hidden from TalkBack.

options.name: hint
options.description: The text under the label. null writes the limits.

options.name: errorText
options.description: The error set on the button while invalid, for TalkBack. Show it visibly with a MonarchFormField.

options.name: validate
options.description: The app's own check after the type and size: return a message to refuse a file.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the strings and plurals monarch_fileupload_*, and the size format.

states.name: default
states.description: The label, the hint with the limits and an enabled Browse files button.

states.name: refused files
states.description: A danger notice lists each refused file with its reason; the zone has the danger border and the button carries the first message as its error.

states.name: limit reached
states.description: The hint says "Limit reached: 3 files attached." and the button is disabled.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted zone, disabled text colors and a disabled button.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Danger border, and errorText is the button's error.

appearance: Zone: a subtle background with the default border and the large container radius, the muted fill when disabled and the danger border when invalid or after a refusal; the label in strong body text, the hint in muted caption text, a small secondary button. Compact: the button and the hint on one line. Refusals are a plain danger MonarchInlineNotice. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web drop zone also accepts dragged and pasted files; on Android files come from the system pickers only (drag and drop from other apps on tablets and ChromeOS is not supported yet). The web takes File objects; Android hands over MonarchPickedFile with the content URI, display name, MIME type and size read from the provider, and never reads the content. accept is a list instead of a comma-separated string. The web capture attribute has no equivalent: for a camera capture use ActivityResultContracts.TakePicture. The web reads the label and error from a surrounding Field; on Android pass invalid and errorText. iOS has no entry yet; the names follow the web.
accessibility: Browse files is a MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target; it is disabled while the component is disabled or full.
"2 files added." is announced through a polite live region after files are accepted.
Refusals are shown as text in a MonarchInlineNotice announced politely, and the first refusal (or errorText while invalid) is the button's error.
The icon is hidden from TalkBack; the label and the hint are read as text.
Texts wrap at the largest font size; the button follows the text in the layout direction.
edgeCases: Files over maxFiles are refused in order after the other checks, so the first valid files are kept.
With multiple false, only the first file a picker returns is checked; any others are refused as too many.
An extension in accept that the system cannot map to a MIME type opens the document picker unfiltered; the check still refuses other files.
The read permission of a picked URI lasts while the app's task lives; take a persistable permission to keep it.
The name and size are read on the main thread when the picker returns; this is a provider query, not a read of the content.

examples.title: With an upload queue
examples.template:
MonarchFileUpload(
    onFiles = { accepted, _ -> attached += accepted },
    accept = listOf({{accept.0}}, {{accept.1}}),
    maxSize = {{maxSize}},
    maxFiles = {{maxFiles}},
    currentCount = attached.size,
    hint = {{hint}},
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Upload, contentDescription = null) },
    labels = MonarchFileUploadLabels(label = {{title}}, browse = {{browse}}),
)
examples.code:
MonarchFileUpload(
    onFiles = { accepted, _ -> attached += accepted },
    accept = listOf("image/*", "application/pdf"),
    maxSize = 10_485_760,
    maxFiles = 5,
    currentCount = attached.size,
    hint = "Images or PDF, up to 10 MB each, 5 files max",
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Upload, contentDescription = null) },
    labels = MonarchFileUploadLabels(label = "Drag and drop files here", browse = "Browse files"),
)

examples.title: Photos from the photo picker, on one line
examples.code:
MonarchFileUpload(
    onFiles = { accepted, _ -> photos += accepted.size },
    variant = MonarchFileUploadVariant.Compact,
    picker = MonarchFileUploadPicker.Media,
    accept = listOf("image/*"),
    labels = MonarchFileUploadLabels(browse = "Choose photos"),
)
